page.layout: One column of centred contents lines below a decorative woodcut ornament at the top. The page number is at the bottom right and the gathering signature at the bottom left. No running head.

l.i: Appendix de Situ, amplitudine, magnificentia, Portu Carthaginis.

page.notes: The large R of the first entry is a woodcut initial, joined to "espublica". The decorative header is an ornament and is not transcribed. Faint show-through from the reverse page is ignored. The first entry's hyphen at the line end is kept as printed ("Carthagi-niensium", "Cartha-ginis", "Creten-sium").
